title: A* Pathfinder with Recursive-Backtracking Maze Generator
description: A Python script that generates random mazes using recursive backtracking, then runs A* pathfinding on them. Shows the maze in ASCII, finds the shortest path from start to goal using Manhattan-distance heuristic, and prints stats: path length, nodes expanded, closed set size, and max open set size. No external dependencies — just heapq, random, and sys.
